text: I’m listening.” “To begin with,” said Tuppence, “what have we to go upon?” “Absolutely nothing,” said Tommy cheerily. “Wrong!” Tuppence wagged an energetic finger. “We have two distinct clues.” “What are they?” “First clue, we know one of the gang.” “Whittington?” “Yes. I’d recognize him anywhere.” “Hum,” said Tommy doubtfully, “I don’t call that much of a clue. You don’t know where to look for him, and it’s about a thousand to one against your running against him by accident.” “I’m not so sure about that,” replied Tuppence thoughtfully.
